reading: Recent reports confirm that severe floods in the Nepal-Tibet border region were likely caused by a collapsed glacier.
These devastating floods have resulted in widespread damage and significant disruption for local communities.
Scientists have undertaken preliminary investigations to determine the precise origins of this recent natural disaster.
Their initial findings strongly indicate that a substantial mass of ice detached, triggering an immense surge of water.
This catastrophic event is highlighting the critical global concern regarding climate change and its severe impact on mountainous glacial areas.
The Himalayan region, often referred to as the 'Third Pole,' is experiencing rapidly melting ice formations at an alarming rate.
Experts are cautioning that such glacial collapses could become increasingly frequent as global temperatures continue to rise.
The sheer destructive power of these sudden floods often leaves affected communities with minimal time to react or prepare.
Governments in the impacted areas are currently evaluating the long-term environmental and socio-economic consequences.
Furthermore, international organizations are providing assistance to help reduce future risks from similar climatic events.

vocabulary.definition: Drawing special attention to something important or making it more noticeable.
Changing from a solid to a liquid state very quickly, often due to high temperatures.
Involving or causing sudden, extensive, or disastrous damage or suffering.
very important, especially at a difficult or dangerous time
results or effects of actions or events
used to add another point to what has already been said
help given to someone who needs it
a problem that stops normal activity

entries.ja: 重要なことに特別な注意を向けたり、より目立たせたりすること。
entries.ko: 중요한 것에 특별한 주의를 기울이거나 더 눈에 띄게 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 引起人们对重要事物特别关注或使其更加引人注目。
entries.es: Llamar la atención de manera especial sobre algo importante o hacerlo más perceptible.
entries.pt-BR: Chamar atenção especial para algo importante ou torná-lo mais perceptível.

entries.ja: 固体の状態から液体の状態へ非常に速く変化すること。多くの場合、高温が原因。
entries.ko: 고체 상태에서 액체 상태로 매우 빠르게 변하는 것, 주로 고온 때문에.
entries.zh-Hans: 由于高温等原因，从固态非常快速地变为液态。
entries.es: Cambiar de estado sólido a líquido muy rápidamente, a menudo debido a altas temperaturas.
entries.pt-BR: Mudar de um estado sólido para um estado líquido muito rapidamente, frequentemente devido a altas temperaturas.

entries.ja: 突然かつ広範囲にわたる、または壊滅的な損害や苦痛を伴う、または引き起こすさま。
entries.ko: 갑작스럽고 광범위하며 재앙적인 손상이나 고통을 포함하거나 유발하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 涉及或导致突然的、广泛的或灾难性的损害或痛苦。
entries.es: Que implica o causa daños o sufrimientos repentinos, extensos o desastrosos.
entries.pt-BR: Que envolve ou causa danos ou sofrimentos súbitos, extensos ou desastrosos.

entries.ja: 特に困難な時や危険な時に、非常に重要であるさま。
entries.ko: 특히 어렵거나 위험한 시기에 매우 중요한.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常重要，尤其是在困难或危险时期。
entries.es: Muy importante, especialmente en un momento difícil o peligroso.
entries.pt-BR: Muito importante, especialmente em um momento difícil ou perigoso.

entries.ja: 行動や出来事の結果または影響。
entries.zh-Hans: 行动或事件的结果或影响。
entries.es: Resultados o efectos de acciones o eventos.
entries.pt-BR: Resultados ou efeitos de ações ou eventos.

entries.ja: すでに述べられたことに別の点を付け加えるために使われる言葉。
entries.ko: 이미 말한 것에 또 다른 요점을 덧붙이기 위해 사용되는 말.
entries.zh-Hans: 用于在已经说过的话之外再补充一点。
entries.es: Se usa para añadir otro punto a lo que ya se ha dicho.
entries.pt-BR: Usado para adicionar outro ponto ao que já foi dito.

entries.ja: 助けが必要な人に与えられる援助。
entries.zh-Hans: 给需要帮助的人提供的帮助。
entries.es: Ayuda que se le da a alguien que la necesita.
entries.pt-BR: Ajuda dada a alguém que precisa dela.

entries.ja: 通常の活動を妨げる問題。
entries.es: Un problema que detiene la actividad normal.
entries.pt-BR: Um problema que impede a atividade normal.
